sentences.en: This corpus is just a giant compilation of independent clauses.
sentences.zh: 这个语料库只是一个独立句子的巨大汇编。

sentences.en: How many one-word Hungarian sentences are there in the corpus?
sentences.zh: 语料库中有多少个匈牙利的一词句？

sentences.en: The Hungarian corpus maintainers do not form a team.
sentences.zh: 维护匈牙利语料库的人并没有组成一个团队。
